about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packages can not be activated on the same account twice!

Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This pack includes:

  • Unique weapon “Long-distance minelayer”

  • Active module “Hypno-beam Toad”

  • Unique engine modifier “Circe engines”

  • Unique capacitor modifier “Weapon booster Black jack”

  • 60 monocrystals

  • A set of resources, 50 pcs. each: Vanadium ore, Silicon ore, Graphite ore, Osmium ore + 50 Crystal shards

  • Unique pattern “Wood grain”

  • Unique title “Space courier”

  • Unique portrait “Lia Cohen”

  • Decor “Flexor”

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 15 days!
